AP: within-group noninterpolated average precision with equal-score thresholds grouped; no positives undefined, all positives=1; never substitute for undefined AUROC
AUROC: within-group positive-vs-negative pair concordance; ties=.5; undefined if either class absent
BAG_semantics: component_i=beta+a dot f_i; BAG logits=mean_i component_i. Raw weighted terms exclude bias. Changing one actual image with other7 fixed changes BAG logits by component_delta/8 and squared full-logit loss by1/64. Conditional single-slice response is not a region independently explaining an entire CT.
aggregation: macro mean of defined per-group metrics, with defined/undefined source-group denominators; no pooled160-slice inferential accuracy, CI or independent-patient claim
distribution: retain per-position scores/reference status, within-group positive/negative count/mean/median/min/max and ordering; no cross-group threshold fit
mechanism: Known-reference sampling omission only if paired original8 all negative and resolved scan reference has positives; low feature/aggregation/lesion mechanisms remain hypotheses, no forced assignment
original_target: ORIGINAL_ARGMAX_FIXED from saved original BAG prediction; Normal class0 responses must not be called infection maps; aggregate original targets separately by class0/class1
partial_denominator: Native PARTIALLY_PAIRED means at least1 confirmed native position and incomplete native reference. Only confirmed fixed8 positions enter separate secondary analysis; zero confirmed fixed8 positions are excluded while native status is preserved. Top2 requires >=2 confirmed fixed8 positions; never interpreted as top2 of all8 or merged with primary.
primary_denominator: PAIRED groups with all8 confirmed and full native reference extent resolved; each source group has equal weight

random_reference.selection: one permutation of exactly the same confirmed positions; no search/selection

ranking_ties: descending score, then ascending native Z index; never medical label
scope: Original observed-development20 source groups, original K8 only; saved JSON contributions, no feature/CT/weight/model read
top_k_metrics: number of positive references in top2
top_k_rationale: Fixed two leading positions (25% of the original8), chosen before any medical labels; not selected by GT or observed performance
unknown_conflict: never negative, never included in metric denominators; all20 groups must remain in registry with explicit status/reason
